digest.component_or_area: bug ticket creation and event reduction
propositions: Automated and manual ticket filers must capture the detection channel (canary, CI, review-bot, agent, human-audit, user-report) at ticket creation time via REBAR_DETECTED_BY env var or optional --detected-by CLI flag.
The detected_by field is normalized by strip+lowercase; empty or whitespace-only values are treated as unset; unknown tokens are stamped verbatim with no enum enforcement and creation never fails.

The detected_by field must be projected into compiled state present-only by process_create (mirroring source_*/creation_channel blocks), and events without it must reduce byte-identically to today's behavior.
Jira inbound reconciler (apply_inbound_records.py) intentionally bypasses composer.create_core and does not stamp detected_by, preserving correct unattributed origin for Jira-authored tickets.
